summary: G0290 is one VivaCity camera (counter 249) at Oxford St / Moore Park Rd / Lang Rd with 15 zone-directions from June 2022 to February 2025, with whole-camera outages that the automatic zero_outage fix handles correctly. The Lang Rd left-turn crossing (319) and to a lesser degree the left-turn lane (318), the shared path (296) and the north footpath (297, during commissioning in June 2022) have phantom-count episodes: flat plateaus that often run overnight, and these are set to missing. Site 319's whole record and the high-level regimes of the Moore Park Rd crossing (293), which change level at camera restarts, are marked uncertain. There is one counter, so no series are defined.
